## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Studio B Unisex Salon & Spa?
No. 920, Bazaar Main Road, Ramnagar, Madipakkam, Chennai 600 091 (Near Total gas LPG bunk).

### What facilities does Studio B Unisex Salon & Spa have?
Hair spa, Body massage, Face care, Foot reflexology, Unisex hair styling, Nail art & extensions, Hair colouring, Keratin & straightening, Manicure & pedicure, Men's grooming combos, Women's beauty combos.

### Is Studio B only for women?
No. Studio B is a unisex salon and spa, with services for both men and women.

### Is there a spa membership?
Yes. Rs.10,000 for 12 months covers 8 hours of Balinese, deep tissue or Thai yoga massage. Memberships are non-transferable.

### How do I book an appointment at Studio B Unisex Salon & Spa?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 72003 50345.
